description.narrative: OTRASEX, an Ubia organization in the Dominican Republic, emerged to address the problems that sex workers face on a daily basis. Formed and led by a group of sex workers, OTRASEX fights for the human and labor rights of sex workers through the development of programs, plans and projects that promote their recognition as sex workers and citizens with rights.The grant will support the following specific priorities:- The development of a baseline on regional human rights needs.- The consolidation of regional collective action agendas that feed into a national sex worker agenda.- Meetings with local authorities to socialize local agendas.- Organize subregional and national meetings to make visible the contributions that sex workers make to social development.
